rows.label: original-combined
limitations: cut and CAS have durations but no absolute timestamps
prewarm and reader connect/retire events were not retained
server samples deduplicate by tick and player-presence, so sub-tick frozen transitions can be absent
client frame timestamps are control-reply receipt times, not native frame-generation timestamps
physics fixture has no SIGSTOP CPU limiter; no fixture limiter pause is subtracted
